author: ValWood
body: * **PTHR ID & PTN node:** * **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):** Tor1 https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPBC30D10.10c (unhelpfully, in pombe tor1 is TORC2 signalling and tor2 is TORC1 signalling) * **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue** propagation. (this is even transferred from the pombe paralog when tor1 & tor2 are specific for the 2 signalling pathways) * Add the label 'high priority' if needed. Generally high priority issues affect a lot of proteins, and annotations are incorrect (as opposed to just imprecise).
